verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents vault export of logins and notes [docs-5] and has a dedicated Authenticator import-export page, though the quoted text covers only imports from Google, LastPass and 2FAS [docs-3, docs-14]. The CLI is fully featured, a hands-on report shows `bw list` dumping vault items including TOTP data in plaintext [docs-7, comm-13], and `bw serve` exposes the whole vault over a local REST API [probe-rt-1]. That points to a scriptable way out, but the evidence never confirms that TOTP secrets themselves are exported, or in what open format. missing for 10: explicit documentation that exports include TOTP seeds, a named open/readable export format (e.g. JSON/CSV/otpauth URIs) for the Authenticator app, evidence of exporting to a non-Bitwarden app (the export doc frames transfer as 'to a new Bitwarden vault'), independent corroboration of a successful migration out.
